metas.name: Widow's Bay
metas.description: A skeptical mayor tries to run a cursed New England island full of superstitious residents. It's a well-reviewed new horror series that is both eerie and funny.

metas.name: Phony
metas.description: After a car accident, a young man becomes convinced his mother has been replaced by an impostor. It's a paranoid, unsettling mystery built around a fraught mother-son relationship.

metas.name: Crystal Lake
metas.description: A prequel to the famous camp slasher, set in the doomed town where counselors come to die. It's a new horror series that tells its story at a slow burn.

metas.name: All Her Fault
metas.description: A mother's son vanishes after a playdate, and her search turns up secrets in her own circle. It's an addictive domestic thriller that is easy to binge.

metas.name: The Beast in Me
metas.description: A grieving author becomes obsessed with her charming neighbor, whose wife disappeared. A slow-burn psychological thriller about suspicion, obsession and a man who may be a monster.
